Name: OliviasPixel's Flower Dance Bowlegs
Author: OliviasPixel
Description:
[size=2]Hello everyone!

This mod aims to remove the gaps between the villagers legs during the flower dance. I've taken the sprites for all the bachelors and bachelorettes and edited their flower dance sprites to fix the gaps.

Except for mods that change flower dance sprites, this mod should be compatible with most mods. This mod only changes the flower dance sprites by editing the new sprites onto the characters' sprite sheets.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NqMn8rt.gif[/img]   [img]https://i.imgur.com/sbRDDSc.gif[/img]   [img]https://i.imgur.com/uj1p0kW.gif[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/GEikDfD.gif[/img]﻿

The main file contains the fixed sprites for the vanilla bachelors and bachelorettes.
I'm working on making optional files fixing flower dance bowlegs for custom characters and will publish them as optional files once they're done! (Please check the credits pop-down for credits of mod authors)
[list]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley Expanded (Done!)[/size]
[/list]


This is my first mod so any feedback or advice is appreciated![/size]
